title: chore(objectui): move the console pin from f8267df93aba to 5e15928b4631 before 18.0.0-next.3
body:
Fixes #24134
Clause-②: no

This PR moves the console pin from `f8267df93aba` to `5e15928b4631`, objectui `main` at `5e15928b4631a9dfd0d9bdd7282d1b746cdbaa68` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12844). The new pin carries `8296c6c3ca` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12667) and `9d857c998c` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12722). #23890 and #23933 remain open: they wait on this pin and are not closed here.

The maintainer ordered the pin first (「先移 pin，你负责派发」, 2026-10-17), ahead of 18.0.0-next.3. This PR is not a release act: the Version Packages PR #23825 is not touched, and no release workflow is dispatched.

**Tier:** not governed. `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch origin/claude/issue-24134-console-pin-next3`: 0 of 5 paths hit the register. Size: 5 files, +145 / -14 (159 changed lines, generated files included).

## Choosing the pin

- The candidates are objectui `main` commits at or after both `8296c6c3ca` and `9d857c998c`. `git merge-base --is-ancestor` exits 0 for both against `5e15928b4631`, and `5e15928b4631` is an ancestor of objectui `origin/main`.
- CI state comes from `repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/commits/SHA/check-runs`, read at 2026-10-17 ~03:13Z:
  - `5e15928b4631`: 68 runs, 65 success and 3 skipped, none in progress. **Completed green.**
  - `0812a190f6` (#12846, the next commit): 2 coverage shards still in progress.
  - `b921f909` (the tip by then): 30 runs still in progress.
- `5e15928b4631` was the tip when #24134 was filed, and its CI was still running then. It was the newest completed-green commit when the bump ran, and it builds against this tree (below), so it is the pin.
- Range `f8267df93aba..5e15928b4631`: 82 non-merge commits.

## Gate (a): Console Pin Gate, local equivalent

1. Client closure: `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=@objectstack/client --filter=@objectstack/sdui-parser --filter=@objectstack/spec`. 34/34 tasks passed.
2. `pnpm objectui:build` (`scripts/build-console.sh`) at the new pin, run under the verify lock, ended with `VERDICT command-exit 0`:
   - bundle canary `import/jobs` present;
   - exactly one zod version literal, `{major:4,minor:6,patch:7}`, across 2258 `assets/*.js` files;
   - "Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it" (3 of 3 injected-only descriptions present, 1 of 1 published-only absent);
   - "@objectstack/console dist ready (64908 KB) from objectui@5e15928b4631".
3. `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` reads `5e15928b4631a9dfd0d9bdd7282d1b746cdbaa68`. `pnpm check:console-sha` reads "Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@5e15928b4631)". `pnpm check:console-injection` passes. Both exit 0.

That local build ran before the manifest was regenerated, so it warned that the shipped copy of `sdui.manifest.json` named `f8267df93aba`. The tracked file is now regenerated (below). `packages/console/dist/` is untracked, and CI builds it fresh.

## The second half: manifest and lockstep record

- `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` read `.cache/objectui-5e15928b4631/apps/console` and wrote 107 components (sha256 `5c47c5b98cc2…`). It also re-recorded `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` at the pin, with `@object-ui/core` 17.7.0.
- `sdui.manifest.json` changes in two components. Both changes come from objectui commits in the range:
  - `list-view` (`plugin-list`) publishes `data` and `type` in place of `objectName` and `viewType`. This is objectui `5c0846ebd` (objectui#12099), which writes a page `list-view` node in the spec's own list view spelling. `ListViewSchema` here declares only `data` and `type`.
  - `page:header.maxVisible`'s description changes (objectui `80863adea`, objectui#12705).
  - No component is added or removed.
- `OBJECTUI_ROOT=.cache/objectui-5e15928b4631 pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep` re-recorded `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` at the pin. Before the re-record, `check:sdui-lockstep` reported one `pin-moved` finding. After it, the gate passes: the grammar blob `0131f27cf86d` and the predicate blob `76c18fb95d1f` are unchanged (214 grammar lines, 25 codes, 7 sources). No parser port is owed.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exits 0, and it confirms `@object-ui 17.7.0` from the objectui checkout.

## Spec Shape Gate and pin citations

- **Spec Shape Gate:** the pin does not reach this gate. It compiles objectui `main`, not `.objectui-sha` (see "Why the clone is objectui `main`, not the pin" in `.github/workflows/spec-shape-gate.yml`). Its `pull_request` trigger is filtered to its own three files, so it does not run on this PR. No registry row is added.
- **`check:objectui-pin-citations`:** this tree has no such script. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:objectui-pin-citations` answers `ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_RUN_NO_SCRIPT`, and `git grep` finds the name only in `CHANGELOG.md` and `.changeset/pre/` text. It is not in the derived gate list either. No citation line is edited.
- `normaliseOptions` (objectui `packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts`) does not change between `f8267df93aba` and `5e15928b4631`. `git log f8267df93aba..origin/main` on that file is empty, and the function body hashes the same at both ends. PR #24072's description of it holds at the new pin.

## The console changeset

`.changeset/24134-console-pin-5e15928b4631.md` was written by `scripts/bump-objectui.sh --no-commit 5e15928b4631…` and renamed from the script's `console-5e15928b4631.md` to this card's prefix.

- `@objectstack/console` **minor**: 88 releasing changesets across 82 non-merge commits, 3 annotated breaking, 3 release-nothing, and 2 commits without a changeset.
- The script's ADR-0087 placeholder is answered `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. Each of the three breaking entries is answered against this tree:
  - `236624d56`: the designer reads and writes `visibleWhen` only. The spec here already retires the form view's `visibleOn` (ADR-0089 D2).
  - `378896da6` and `5c0846ebd`: a page `list-view` node is spelled `data` / `type`. `ListViewSchema` here declares no `objectName` or `viewType`.
- The body carries `Clause-②: no`, as the precedent pin changeset does.
- `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` and `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` all exit 0.

## Verification, at `bfcc588b`

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` (no paths, merge base `c1c0a9094`) derived 70 commands. Each was run, with its exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` with exit codes reads "70 derived, 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (a DERIVED zero)".
- Two commands first exited 3 (prerequisite not met). Both were re-run green at the same head:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: its fixture commit `621a48760` was outside the shallow clone. After `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a48760…` it passed 48 cases.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: it needs a full build. `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=!@objectstack/docs` passed 76/76, and the gate then passed (111 entries, 69 packages).
- This PR changes no package source, so no package `test` / `typecheck` is owed.

## Acceptance notes

- #23890 and #23933 remain open. They can be re-read once this pin lands.
- objectui `main` has moved on (`0812a190f6`, `b921f909`), and those commits were still running CI when the pin was chosen. They go with the next hop.
